newsitem.title: USA: IES 538 MW Iowa plant resumes power output.
newsitem.headline: IES 538 MW Iowa plant resumes power output.

text.p: IES Utilities' 538 megawatt Duane Arnold nuclear power plant has resumed electricity production and is boosting power, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Friday.
The unit, located at Palo, Iowa, was producing at 25 percent of capacity and boosting output further as of early Friday, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
The Duane Arnold plant was shut Saturday to repair a leak in a water line in the plant's heat recovery system.
IES has a 70 percent interest in the plant, with two Iowa power cooperatives holding the remaining 30 percent.
